units.passage: You ARE allowed to use ChatGPT, Google Bard, Bing AI, or similar AI chatbots as you would a library resource. For example, you can use ChatGPT to find solutions for errors the same way you would use Stackoverflow or other Internet resources, or to understand and improve software you are developing. You ARE allowed to use AI chatbots to verify algorithms. You will learn more if you develop your algorithms yourself and use a chatbot to verify them, rather than taking the shortcut of simply (for example) asking ChatGPT to generate the algorithms for you.
units.why: 'You ARE allowed to use AI chatbots to verify algorithms' permits using AI to check one's own work: P14 (self-checks), with the condition that students develop the algorithm themselves.
units.fit_note: Verification of an algorithm the student wrote, permitted only if the student develops it first. | Verification of algorithms the student already developed, not practice problems or study aids.

units.passage: Students might share course materials with AI tools to study, simplify complicated instructions, prepare for class, or support academic accommodations such as live notetaking. units.passage: Students may consult AI generative tools in limited situations.
